title: kate-ui: bind ctrl-a and ctrl-e to the line edge
summary: ctrl-a moves to the line start. ctrl-e moves to the line end. The shift forms extend that move. cmd-a still selects all. The test goes in the existing keys tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: keys.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Add four rows to MOVE_BINDINGS before its closing bracket. ctrl-a is Movement::LineStart and Extend::No. ctrl-e is Movement::LineEnd and Extend::No. ctrl-shift-a is Movement::LineStart and Extend::Yes. ctrl-shift-e is Movement::LineEnd and Extend::Yes. The stored names use modifier order ctrl, alt, shift, cmd. Do not touch edit_binding, text_binding, normalize_binding, command_for_binding, move_binding, caret_marks, selection_spans, visible_selection_spans, reveal_line, or scroll_y_for_line. Do not change cmd-a, cmd-left, ctrl-z, alt-left, or alt-right. The test ctrl_a_moves_to_the_line_start calls command_for_binding. ctrl-a and the same binding return Move LineStart Extend::No. ctrl-e returns Move LineEnd Extend::No. ctrl-shift-a and shift-ctrl-a return Move LineStart Extend::Yes. ctrl-shift-e returns Move LineEnd Extend::Yes. cmd-a still returns SelectAll. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::ctrl_a_moves_to_the_line_start
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because ctrl-a returns None. After the change ctrl-a moves to the line start. ctrl-e moves to the line end. ctrl-shift-a and shift-ctrl-a extend to the line start. ctrl-shift-e extends to the line end. cmd-a still selects all.
